column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3: The supports gave way!\nMen are trapped inside.{page_break}Water's pouring in.\nPlease, will you help?{end_now}
Thank you!\nThere's no time to lose.{end_wait}
Please find someone.\nI can't leave my friends\nin there alone.{end_wait}
The roof may fall\nif we shift the rocks.\nWe need to brace it.{end_wait}
I'll find a beam!\nIsaac, help me\nhold it in place.{end_wait}
Don't move that stone.\nIt's holding up\npart of the roof.{end_wait}
Garet, brace the roof.\nThen we clear a path.\nMove together.{end_wait}
I heard them calling.\nI thought we'd be too late.{page_break}Here. Take this.\nIt's all I can give.{end_wait}
Everyone got out.\nThe mine can wait.\nWe're going home.{end_wait}
